build_bert_model: build a BERT model from config to get embeddings, encoder layers, and pooled output for a token sequence
build_bert_for_classification: build a BERT sequence classification model with a linear classifier head on the pooled [CLS] output
build_bert_for_qa: build a BERT question answering model that predicts start and end span logits for extractive QA
load_bert_pretrained: load a pretrained BERT model from a local directory containing bert_config.json and pytorch_model.bin weights
load_bert_from_tf: load a BERT model from a TensorFlow checkpoint file using the from_tf flag in from_pretrained
